title: DMZ, segmentation and designing trust zones

videos.script: Picture a castle. A strong wall, and everything inside trusted because it is inside. That picture is the problem. {{castle}} In a flat network, one machine that falls reaches every other one. Before any rule is loaded, a stranger on the internet reaches the company's database. {{flat}} This lesson divides the network into zones, each trusted differently. You will write the policy as a table first: which zone may start a conversation with which, on what. Then as rules, one per cell. {{matrix}} Then you will test every cell from the zone where it starts. {{probe}} Last, the question segmentation really answers. The shop's server will be compromised one day. From there, what can the attacker reach? {{blast}}
